2608.00937.title: Neuro-Symbolic Participation Governance for Verifiable AI Agents in Open Digital Twin Ecosystems
2608.00937.paper_summary: Autonomous AI agents, increasingly empowered by large language models, are becoming important components of human-machine systems for high-stakes decision support in digital twin ecosystems. However, existing multi-agent systems often lack robust verification for identity, capability, and policy compliance, especially in decentralized environments spanning multiple institutions. This paper proposes a neuro-symbolic decentralized governance framework for verifiable agents in collaborative digital twin environments. By representing agents through multi-layer semantic profiles, the framework bridges probabilistic neural reasoning with deterministic institutional governance, thereby supporting trustworthy human-AI collaboration and meaningful human oversight. Capabilities are grounded in formal domain ontologies to enable machine-interpretable, policy-aware, and context-sensitive participation. These credentials, issued by organizational authorities, are validated via blockchain-based smart contracts, ensuring auditable participation without exposing sensitive data. We demonstrate the framework using a decision-support prototype with clinic, digital twin, and wearable provider agents effectively prevents unauthorized interaction and enforces institutional policies with manageable overhead. Our findings suggest that neuro-symbolic decentralized governance provides a scalable and trustworthy pathway for safe human-machine collaboration across institutional boundaries.
2608.00937.paper_summary_zh: 自主 AI 代理，隨著大型語言模型的強化，正成為數位雙胞胎生態系統中人機系統的重要組成部分，用於高風險決策支持。<lb/>然而，現有的多代理系統往往缺乏對身份、能力和政策遵從性的穩健驗證，特別是在跨越多個機構的去中心化環境中。<lb/>本文提出了一種神經符號去中心化治理框架，用於在協作數位雙胞胎環境中驗證代理。<lb/>通過通過多層語義檔案來表示代理，該框架將概率神經推理與確定性機構治理相結合，從而支持可信的人機協作和有意義的人類監督。<lb/>能力基於正式的領域本體，使機器可解釋、政策意識和上下文敏感的參與成為可能。<lb/>這些由組織權威機構發出的憑證，通過基於區塊鏈的智能合約進行驗證，確保可審計的參與而不暴露敏感數據。<lb/>我們使用一個決策支持原型來演示該框架，該原型與診所、數位雙胞胎和可穿戴提供者代理有效地防止未經授權的互動，並以可管理的開銷執行機構政策。<lb/>我們的研究結果表明，神經符號去中心化治理為跨機構邊界的安全人機協作提供了一條可擴展且可信的途徑。
